name: app-morning-lark-light-schedule-screen-beside-hand-drawn-sketch
title: Butter-yellow board with a 'Morning Lark' schedule phone and a hand-sketched 'Body Clock' wireframe
whatItIs: A butter-yellow field with a white phone at left showing 'Light diet for Morning Lark', bed and wake time pills with a sync toggle and a timeline of coloured blocks (Tmin Marker, Wake-Up, Morning Light, Focus, Morning Exercise) with a dark tooltip, and at right a black felt-pen sketch of the same timeline titled 'Body Clock' with hatching and handwritten labels.
whatItMeans: Human and process-led; the raw sketch beside the polished screen shows where the idea came from.
techniques: Show the raw sketch beside the final screen.

vocabulary.definition: A hand sketch shown next to the final UI.
A coloured bar spanning a time range.
A small dark note explaining a state.
